**STEP 1 – Scene:** A mixed meal with soup, sushi, toasted bread, chopped salad and fruit, plus small portions of soy sauce and wasabi.

**STEP 2 – Vessels:** The food is spread across several dishes, so I estimate each separately: soup bowl ~20 cm (314 cm²); salad bowl ~18 cm (254 cm²); sushi plate ~23 cm (415 cm²); toast plate ~20 cm (314 cm²); fruit bowl ~20 cm (314 cm²); sauce cups ~5 cm each.

**STEP 3–6 – Items, coverage, volume and weight:**
- Soup: ~65% of bowl × 1.1 cm = 224 ml; at 1.0 g/ml, **224 g**.
- Tomato-cucumber salad: ~40% × 1.4 cm = 143 ml; at 0.6 g/ml, **86 g**.
- Sushi rolls: ~30% of plate × 1.6 cm = 200 ml; at 0.8 g/ml, **160 g**.
- Toasted bread: ~25% of plate × 1.8 cm = 141 ml; at 0.95 g/ml, **134 g**.
- Mixed fruit: ~45% of bowl × 2.5 cm = 353 ml; at 0.62 g/ml, **219 g**.
- Soy sauce: ~12 ml, **12 g**. Wasabi: ~5 ml, **5 g**.

**STEP 7 – Energy estimate:** Soup ~40 kcal/100 g; salad ~25; sushi ~160; toasted bread ~280; mixed fruit ~55; soy sauce ~53; wasabi ~100.

**STEP 8 – Sanity check:** The estimated total is about **840 g** and **850 kcal**. This includes all the visible dishes and condiments.
